scripts.build: bun run prisma:generate && cd frontend && bun run build && cd ../backend && bun run build
scripts.lint: cd backend && bun run lint && cd ../frontend && bun run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && bunx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json
scripts.test: cd backend && bun run test && cd ../frontend && bun run test
scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: cd backend && bunx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: cd backend && bunx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:migrate:status: cd backend && bunx prisma migrate status
scripts.prisma:reset: cd backend && bunx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.prisma:seed: cd backend && bunx prisma db seed
scripts.test:db:prepare: docker exec appofc-postgres-1 psql -U autodisplay -d autodisplay -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'autodisplay_test'" | grep -q 1 || docker exec appofc-postgres-1 psql -U autodisplay -d autodisplay -c "CREATE DATABASE autodisplay_test"
